name: flickering-grid
title: Flickering Grid
description: A grid of tiny squares whose brightness flickers at random, like a dim LED panel: a quiet tech texture under titles and UI.

moworks.author: magicui
moworks.call: MW.flickeringGrid(q(".mw-flickering-grid"), tl, 0, { squareSize: 8, gridGap: 8, color: "#60A5FA", maxOpacity: 0.6, flickerChance: 1.2, hold: 6 });

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: el is a <canvas> sized by its box (device pixels follow window.devicePixelRatio as upstream). Docs say maxOpacity 0.2: the code has 0.3 (the code wins).
moworks.titleVi: Lưới ô vuông nhấp nháy như bảng LED
